places.name: Burnham Park
places.ai_summary: A sprawling urban park in the heart of Baguio, offering boating, biking, and picnic spots for visitors.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Rent a boat for a relaxing experience on the lake.

places.name: Mines View Park
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint offering panoramic views of the Cordillera mountains and a glimpse into the region's mining history.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during clear weather.

places.place_tip: Shop for local souvenirs and silver jewelry nearby.

attribution.title: Mines View Park, Baguio City
attribution.author: Lawrence Ruiz

places.name: Camp John Hay & Eco-Trail
places.ai_summary: A historical site and recreational area featuring a golf course, picnic spots, and eco-trail for nature walks.

opening_hours.notes: Eco-Trail access may close during heavy rains.

places.place_tip: Try the horseback riding activity available on-site.

places.name: Bencab Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the works of Benedicto Cabrera, featuring contemporary Philippine art and a beautiful garden.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 5:00 PM. Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the café with a view at the museum.

places.name: La Trinidad Strawberry Farm
places.ai_summary: A popular farm destination in nearby La Trinidad, known for its strawberry picking activity and fresh produce.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the strawberry season (November to May).

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and shoes for farming activities.

places.name: Session Road Cafés
places.ai_summary: A famous street in Baguio known for its vibrant café culture, offering a variety of local and international coffee blends.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual café hours as they may vary.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies paired with your coffee.

places.name: Tam-Awan Village
places.ai_summary: A reconstructed traditional Cordillera village showcasing indigenous culture, art, and crafts.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes for walking around the village.

places.place_tip: Participate in the weaving and pottery workshops offered.
places.address: Tam-Awan Village, Pinsao Proper, Baguio, Philippines

places.name: Wright Park & The Mansion
places.ai_summary: A historical park featuring the official summer residence of the Philippine President and a pool of the famous Wright Park.

opening_hours.notes: The Mansion is not open to the public but the park is.

places.place_tip: Take photos at the iconic yellow gate of The Mansion.

places.name: Sagada Hanging Coffins
places.ai_summary: A famous cultural site in Sagada where coffins are hung on cliffs, showcasing the unique burial practices of the Igorot people.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a local guide for cultural insights.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trek to the nearby caves.

places.name: Sumaguing Cave (Sagada)
places.ai_summary: A popular cave in Sagada known for its impressive limestone formations and adventure trekking.

opening_hours.notes: Wear appropriate clothing and footwear for caving.

places.place_tip: Hire a local guide for a safer and more informative experience.
places.address: Sumaguing Cave, Sagada, Mountain Province, Philippines

places.name: Bomod-Ok Falls
places.ai_summary: A stunning waterfall in Sagada, also known as the 'Big Falls', accessible via a scenic trek.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season (November to April).

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks for the trek to the falls.
places.address: Bomod-Ok Falls, Sagada, Mountain Province, Philippines

places.name: Echo Valley Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walk in Sagada offering views of the rice terraces, pine forests, and the famous hanging coffins.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a local guide for safety and navigation.

places.place_tip: Listen to the echo of your voice in the valley.
places.address: Echo Valley, Sagada, Mountain Province, Philippines
